quotes.title: HAT-P-38
quotes.card: HAT-P-38, formally named Horna, is a star located in the northern constellation Triangulum.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent magnitude of 12.51, making it readily visible in amateur telescopes but not to the naked eye.
